questions.content: The compound that does NOT liberate CO2, on treatment with aqueous sodium bicarbonate solution, is
questions.explanation: Comparatively phenol is a weaker acidic than carbonic acid (H2CO3), and hence does not liberate CO2 on treatment with aqueous NaHCO3 solution. The rest are more acidic than H2CO3, and so liberate CO2.
